Sync Key & Pairing

Pair your phone and keep your deadlines in sync

Live Sync

Access your deadlines on your phone via Mobile Web App (PWA) and subscribe natively in Apple Calendar (iOS) or Google Calendar.

Keeps your deadlines private and isolated in the cloud so multiple students never overwrite each other.

On your phone, open the Blackboarder app (blackboarder.pages.dev/companion, a web app, not in the App Store), go to Settings > Sync and tap Scan QR. It pairs right away, AI included. The code carries your AI pass, so only show it to your own phone.

Backup & Data

Export or restore your deadlines offline

Local Storage

Your scanned deadlines are safely stored in browser storage. Export a JSON backup file anytime for 100% peace of mind.

Delete My Online Data

Erase what is stored under your sync key

Privacy

Blackboarder keeps a copy of your deadlines, courses, quick links, your encrypted AI key and your phone's reminder subscription online so your phone can see them. This deletes all of it from the server, and you get a new sync key. Your deadlines stay on this device, and your phone needs to be paired again.

AI & Extraction Engine

Built-in parser with an optional AI model

Hybrid Engine

The built-in parser reads announcements on its own. If you add an API key, an AI model reads only the ones the parser cannot date. Without a key, the built-in parser is used automatically. The web app uses the same model through your server, so set it up here.

Enable AI Deep Extraction Use an AI model for conversational announcements
Used when local parser encounters ambiguous or conversational announcements.
Each provider keeps its own key, so switching back loses nothing.
Only phones opened with the pairing link can use this model. A new pass signs all phones out of AI until you send the link again.
Auto-Scan on Page Load Automatically inspects Blackboard announcements when visiting stream

Scanner Maintenance & Cache

Checkpoint cache and rescan utilities

Non-Destructive

Blackboarder caches scanned announcement IDs to make rescans instant. Full Re-scan refreshes all details without resetting completed tasks. Clear Scan Cache forces a clean re-scan of all announcements from scratch.

Quick Tour

Welcome to Blackboarder

1. Choose Your University

Sets the grading scale for your GPA and your university quick links. You can edit this anytime in Settings.

Not listed? Choose Other for standard 4.0, or scanning any Blackboard page will detect it from the address.

2. Scan Blackboard

Click Scan Blackboard at the bottom right of the page, or press Alt+B to find your quizzes, assignments and exams automatically.

Open your courses page, then click Scan to pull in all deadlines and marks.
Phone App & AI Model
Sync to your phone in Settings > Sync. Optional AI model setup is in Settings > Scanning.
